Jordan, thanks for the recap and quick turnaround.

We attached the vendor questionnaire (see attached) — it's our standard procurement security questionnaire (PDF). A few clarifications from our side:
- SOC 2: We require a SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12-month period. Redacted copies are fine.
- Breach notification: Our security policy asks for notification of confirmed data breaches within 72 hours of detection for regulated data; we mark 72 hours as our expectation for vendors. If you have internal SLAs that are tighter, please call them out.
- BCP/DR evidence: We'll need a high-level runbook or summary that shows RTO/RPO targets and recovery steps for critical services. We don't need full playbooks — a summary doc + a runbook excerpt is fine. 

We also included a contact for audit follow-ups in the questionnaire (you can fill in your point of contact).

Thanks — if you can get the SOC 2 and runbook summary in the next 3 business days that would be ideal.

Best,

Thanks for the ping — happy to own this. Quick answers and what we'll provide: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: We can provide a redacted copy of "SOC2-Type2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf". We'll remove customer-identifying details per our disclosure policy and provide a cover letter explaining redactions. Expect delivery as a password-protected PDF.

2) Incident response & breach notification: Our standard customer-facing policy is to notify customers of confirmed incidents that materially affect customer data within 48 hours of confirmation. For regulatory reporting (e.g., GDPR obligations), we work with customers to ensure timelines meet their compliance requirements; in many managed engagements we aim for notification within 72 hours to align with customer policies. We'll call out both lines in the cover note so FintechCorp can see both the internal SLA (48h) and the operational commitment (72h regulatory alignment).

3) BCP/DR evidence: Attached is a one-page summary (incident_response_runbook_v2_summary.pdf) and we'll provide an excerpt from the runbook (incident_response_runbook_v2.pdf excerpt) showing RTO/RPO for core services (inference runtime: RTO ~2 hours, RPO < 15 minutes for KV cache; control plane services: RTO ~4 hours). We'll include a link to the shared drive with detailed artifacts for auditors.

4) Questionnaire: Jordan, saw the attached FintechCorp_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.pdf. I will start filling the questionnaire; if FintechCorp prefers we fill it in the doc itself and upload, that's fine — otherwise we'll return a completed PDF.

Deliverables and ETA:
- SOC 2 redacted PDF (password-protected): ETA Thu, 2026-07-02 EOD PT
- IR runbook summary + runbook excerpt: ETA Thu, 2026-07-02 EOD PT
- Completed vendor questionnaire (PDF): ETA Fri, 2026-07-03 EOD PT
